offers.title: Unlimited Open Bar
offers.description:
Enjoy the best beverage package at sea! Indulge in unlimited premium spirits such as Grey Goose, Casamigos, Woodford Reserve and more, plus cocktails, wine, beer, soft drinks and juice — all included. Simply pay the package gratuities in advance, and the drinks are on us. With drinks on board averaging $15 each, there’s no better value.

Gratuities are $32 per person, per day for 2–5 night sailings and $28.50 per person, per day for sailings of 6 nights or more. This is reflected in the total price shown above and in the guest breakdown.

The package applies to all guests in the stateroom aged 21+. Guests 1 or 2 under age 21 will instead receive juice and unlimited fountain soda for $12.50 per person per day. Guests 3–8 under 21 will not receive a beverage package but may purchase one separately.

With an average of $60 per meal onboard, this value can’t be beat.
 
The package applies to all guests on the reservation.  Guests under age 13 dine for free when ordering from the kids’ menu. If they choose to order from the specialty dining menu, a $20 cover charge will apply.

offerGroups.description: Free at Sea™ Package

offers.title: Unlimited Open Bar
offers.description:
Enjoy the best beverage package at sea! Indulge in unlimited premium spirits such as Grey Goose, Casamigos, Woodford Reserve and more, plus cocktails, wine, beer, soft drinks and juice — all included. Simply pay the package gratuities in advance, and the drinks are on us. With drinks on board averaging $15 each, there’s no better value.

Gratuities are $32 per person, per day for 2–5 night sailings and $28.50 per person, per day for sailings of 6 nights or more. This is reflected in the total price shown above and in the guest breakdown.

The package applies to all guests in the stateroom aged 21+. Guests 1 or 2 under age 21 will instead receive juice and unlimited fountain soda for $12.50 per person per day. Guests 3–8 under 21 will not receive a beverage package but may purchase one separately.

offers.title: Specialty Dining—50% Off
offers.description:
Savour 1 amazing multi-course meal at our award-winning Specialty Restaurants, such as Cagney’s Steakhouse or Le Bistro. Enjoy elevated dining experiences featuring globally inspired cuisine and exceptional service — all included. Simply pre-pay the package gratuities in advance, and the dining experience is on us. With an average of $60 per meal onboard, this value can’t be beat.
 
The package applies to all guests on the reservation.  Guests under age 13 dine for free when ordering from the kids’ menu. If they choose to order from the specialty dining menu, a $20 cover charge will apply.

offerGroups.description: Free at Sea™ Package

offers.title: Unlimited Open Bar
offers.description:
Enjoy the best beverage package at sea! Indulge in unlimited premium spirits such as Grey Goose, Casamigos, Woodford Reserve and more, plus cocktails, wine, beer, soft drinks and juice — all included. Simply pay the package gratuities in advance, and the drinks are on us. With drinks on board averaging $15 each, there’s no better value.

Gratuities are $32 per person, per day for 2–5 night sailings and $28.50 per person, per day for sailings of 6 nights or more. This is reflected in the total price shown above and in the guest breakdown.

The package applies to all guests in the stateroom aged 21+. Guests 1 or 2 under age 21 will instead receive juice and unlimited fountain soda for $12.50 per person per day. Guests 3–8 under 21 will not receive a beverage package but may purchase one separately.

offers.title: Specialty Dining—50% Off
offers.description:
Savour 1 amazing multi-course meal at our award-winning Specialty Restaurants, such as Cagney’s Steakhouse or Le Bistro. Enjoy elevated dining experiences featuring globally inspired cuisine and exceptional service — all included. Simply pre-pay the package gratuities in advance, and the dining experience is on us. With an average of $60 per meal onboard, this value can’t be beat.
 
The package applies to all guests on the reservation.  Guests under age 13 dine for free when ordering from the kids’ menu. If they choose to order from the specialty dining menu, a $20 cover charge will apply.

Indulge in unlimited premium spirits such as Grey Goose, Casamigos, Woodford Reserve and more, plus cocktails, wine, beer, soft drinks and juice — all included. Simply pay the package gratuities in advance, and the drinks are on us. With drinks on board averaging $15 each, there’s no better value.

Gratuities are $32 per person, per day for 2–5 night sailings and $28.50 per person, per day for sailings of 6 nights or more. This is reflected in the total price shown above and in the guest breakdown.

The package applies to all guests in the stateroom aged 21+. Guests 1 or 2 under age 21 will instead receive juice and unlimited fountain soda for $12.50 per person per day. Guests 3–8 under 21 will not receive a beverage package but may purchase one separately.

offers.title: Specialty Dining—50% Off
offers.description:
Savour 1 amazing multi-course meal at our award-winning Specialty Restaurants, such as Cagney’s Steakhouse or Le Bistro. Enjoy elevated dining experiences featuring globally inspired cuisine and exceptional service — all included. Simply pre-pay the package gratuities in advance, and the dining experience is on us. With an average of $60 per meal onboard, this value can’t be beat.
 
The package applies to all guests on the reservation.  Guests under age 13 dine for free when ordering from the kids’ menu. If they choose to order from the specialty dining menu, a $20 cover charge will apply.
